relationships.subject: Tiam1
relationships.evidence_quote: Tiam1 functions as a GEF to activate the small GTPase Rac1

relationships.subject: Tiam1
relationships.evidence_quote: These findings indicate that Tiam1 is essential for the increase in synaptic NMDAR activity of spinal dorsal horn neurons during the development of neuropathic pain.

relationships.subject: Tiam1
relationships.evidence_quote: the Rac1-GEF Tiam1 induces actin polymerization in the spinal dorsal horn

relationships.subject: Rac1
relationships.evidence_quote: The expression of constitutively-active Rac1Q61L-eGFP, but not control eGFP, in the spinal dorsal horn rescued neuropathic pain phenotypes in global Tiam1 KO mice subjected to SNI

relationships.subject: NSC23766
relationships.evidence_quote: a widely used small molecule inhibitor that prevents Rac1 activation by the Rac1-specific GEFs Tiam1 and Trio

relationships.subject: Tiam1 antisense oligonucleotide
relationships.evidence_quote: These data indicate that ASO targeting of spinal Tiam1 alleviates neuropathic pain hypersensitivity.

key_findings: Tiam1-Rac1 signaling in spinal dorsal horn excitatory neurons drives actin polymerization, spine growth and synaptic NMDAR stabilization required for initiation, transition and maintenance of neuropathic pain.
Spinal Tiam1 ASO and NSC23766 alleviate neuropathic pain.
